mechanics.name: Hardened
mechanics.currentEffect: After you unlock a Chest and cleanse or bless a Totem, Hardened activates for the rest of the Trial. Whenever you would scream for any reason, the scream is suppressed and the Killer's Aura is revealed to you instead for 3/4/5 seconds.
activation: Cleanse or bless a Totem; both the Chest and Totem conditions must be completed.
Ends/deactivates when: The perk remains active for the rest of the Trial after both activation actions.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: After opening a Chest and interacting with a Totem, your screams are replaced by brief Killer Aura reveals.
duration: Perk activation persists for the rest of the Trial.
Each Killer Aura reveal lasts 3/4/5 seconds (Tier I/II/III).
specialInteractions: Any event that would make you scream can trigger the effect; the scream is suppressed and replaced with the Killer Aura reveal.

editorial.summary: After opening a chest and cleansing or blessing a Totem, all future screams are suppressed and replaced with a Killer Aura reveal for up to 5 seconds.
useCases: Turn Killer scream-information perks into reciprocal Killer Aura reads.
Suppress scream-based tracking for the remainder of the Trial once fully activated.
Use chest and Totem interactions from an existing build to reduce the setup tax.
counters: Requires both a Chest unlock and a Totem cleanse or blessing before activation.
Some matches contain little or no scream-based Killer information.
pros: Converts an enemy information trigger into your own information.
cons: Very weak if the Killer never makes you scream.
analysis: Hardened closes this band because its active effect is clever but the startup cost is enormous. You must first unlock a chest and interact with a Totem before the perk begins functioning at all.

Once active, the effect can be excellent against scream-heavy information. Every would-be scream is suppressed and converted into a Killer Aura read, simultaneously denying the Killer a cue and giving you one.

The problem is that the player pays the setup cost before knowing how often the payoff will matter. A Killer with no relevant scream effects can leave Hardened functionally blank after you already spent time opening and cleansing.

That combination of expensive activation and matchup dependency places Hardened at the bottom of B. In the right counter-build it is satisfying and strong; as a blind queue perk it is too speculative.
editorial.verdict: A clever hard counter buried under two setup chores. Hardened is excellent against the right scream build and difficult to justify before you know the matchup.
